segments.name: commercial banking
products: demand, money market, and certificates of deposit accounts
segments.description: A community commercial bank providing loans, deposits and treasury management to individuals, professionals and small to medium-sized businesses in California.
segments.evidence: We operate one reportable segment — commercial banking.

revenueModel.text: The bank earns interest and fees from loans, investments and deposits provided to individuals, professionals and small to medium-sized businesses.
revenueModel.evidence: Loans, investments, and deposits provide the revenues from the Company's operations.

changes.text: In 2024 the company completed its merger with California BanCorp, expanding its footprint into Northern California.
In 2024 the company changed its name from Southern California Bancorp to California BanCorp.
changes.evidence: In connection with the Merger, our shareholders also approved a change of the Company's name from Southern California Bancorp to California BanCorp.
